# TableLab

> TableLab is a free poker bankroll tracker for cash games and tournaments, available on Android and the web. It logs sessions (including a live session recorder), records full street-by-street hand histories, runs offline equity, variance, and ICM calculators, holds a browsable library of solver-computed strategies (the Study tab), tracks player reads, and provides solver-grounded AI coaching on sessions and individual hands. Built and operated by MagpiQ, an independent software studio in Ontario, Canada.

## Key facts

- Price: Free. Core tracking, hand recorder, equity calculator, and dashboard cost nothing; AI coaching has a generous free daily allowance.
- Platforms: Android via Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pokertracker.poker_tracker) and any modern web browser at https://tablelab.app
- Privacy: No ads. Data is never sold. Records are private per-account, protected by row-level security. Data is only sent to Anthropic (Claude) when the user explicitly taps "Analyse".
- Maker: MagpiQ, a sole proprietorship based in Ontario, Canada.

## Features

- Session tracking — log cash and tournament sessions with stakes, buy-in, cash-out, table size, duration, and notes, or run the live recorder to track rebuys, breaks, and expenses in real time.
- Hand recorder — record full hand histories street by street, from heads-up to 9-handed, and replay them on a table.
- AI coaching — Claude explains your sessions and hands in plain English, grounded in computed equity and solver-derived GTO frequencies (where the spot is covered), never invented numbers.
- Study tab — a browsable library of solver-computed strategies for common preflop battles: how often each hand bets, checks, calls, or raises on any flop, turn, and river. Computed offline with a licensed CFR solver (TexasSolver); the app does not solve arbitrary spots on demand.
- Equity calculator — range-vs-range equity with GTO presets and Monte Carlo simulation, fully offline.
- Variance calculator — risk of ruin, expected downswings, and bankroll targets from a win rate or the user's own logged results.
- ICM calculator — Malmuth–Harville equities for tournament and final-table spots.
- Player reads — track opponent tendencies and turn tags into rule-based insights.
- Stats dashboard — tap any stat (profit, win rate, BB/100, ROI) to chart it over time; breakdowns by stakes, day, time, and location; cash vs tournament side by side; multi-currency display.

## Pages

- [About / Home](https://tablelab.app/about): Overview, features, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Open App](https://tablelab.app/): The TableLab web app (interactive UI only — client-rendered, not a content page; cite /about for product details).
- [Blog](https://tablelab.app/blog/): Honest, solver-grounded writing for live cash and tournament players.
- [Poker Variance Calculator](https://tablelab.app/variance-calculator): Free in-browser variance calculator for cash and tournaments — expected result, 70%/95% outcome ranges, chance of losing, risk of ruin, and the bankroll needed for a 5% or 1% risk of ruin.
- [ICM Deal Calculator](https://tablelab.app/icm-calculator): Free in-browser ICM (Independent Chip Model) calculator for final-table deals — exact Malmuth–Harville equity vs a chip-chop split, up to 9 players.
- [Can AI Solve Poker?](https://tablelab.app/blog/can-ai-solve-poker): What LLMs do vs. what solvers do, and how to spot AI hype.
- [Poker Bankroll Management](https://tablelab.app/blog/poker-bankroll-management): How many buy-ins you need for live cash and tournaments, the risk-of-ruin math, and why live differs from online.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tablelab.app/privacy): Data collection, processors, and user rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://tablelab.app/terms): Terms governing use of TableLab.
